newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein to buy two Dutch distributors.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein to buy two Dutch distributors.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc said on Thursday that it had signed letters of intent to acquire two Dutch healthcare products distributors.

Henry Schein did not disclose a purchase price for the businesses, which are both privately held, but said they had combined 1996 sales in excess of $4.0 million. Both transactions are expected to close within 60 days, the company said in a statement.

In the first transaction, Henry Schein said it planned to buy a majority share in Adriaan van der Kuip Medische Instrumenten BV, a distributor of healthcare products and services to general practitioners.
Henry Schein also signed a separate letter to acquire the assets of Wigro Medische en Chirurgische Instrumentenhandel BV, a distributor of high quality surgical instruments in Holland.
Henry Schein Inc is a direct marketer of healthcare products and services to office-based healthcare practitioners.
